tagline: The statue capital of Europe — a bazaar older than most cities, a river of monuments, and Mother Teresa's hometown.
overview: Skopje is the strangest-looking capital in Europe — and deliberately so. The 'Skopje 2014' project filled the centre with hundreds of statues, faux-baroque facades and a fleet of classical buildings, anchored by a giant Alexander the Great fountain over the Vardar river.

Across the Stone Bridge, the Old Bazaar — one of the Balkans' largest — keeps its Ottoman lanes of goldsmiths, ćevapi grills and tea gardens alive, overlooked by Kale Fortress and the 6th-century walls.
Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Skopje. Mother Teresa was born here (the house site is a memorial), and Matka Canyon — boat trips to cave lakes and cliff monasteries — sits 15km from downtown.

funFacts.title: STATUE CITY
funFacts.text: The Skopje 2014 project added hundreds of statues and neoclassical facades in one go.

funFacts.title: GIANT ALEXANDER
funFacts.text: The Warrior on a Horse fountain — officially not Alexander, wink — towers 22 metres.

funFacts.title: MOTHER TERESA'S TOWN
funFacts.text: She was born here in 1910 — a memorial marks the family home site.

funFacts.title: THE OLD BAZAAR
funFacts.text: Čaršija is among the Balkans' largest Ottoman bazaars — goldsmiths still work there.

funFacts.title: 6TH-CENTURY FORTRESS
funFacts.text: Kale Fortress's walls watched empires from the Romans to the Ottomans.

funFacts.title: MATKA CANYON
funFacts.text: Cliff monasteries, caves and boat trips 15 minutes from the statues.

funFacts.title: MILLENNIUM CROSS
funFacts.text: The 66-metre cross on Vodno mountain — reachable by cable car — is visible city-wide.

funFacts.title: THE 1963 QUAKE
funFacts.text: An earthquake destroyed 80% of the city — it was rebuilt with global help, including a Kenzo Tange master plan.

funFacts.title: TWO NAMES
funFacts.text: The country resolved its name dispute in 2019: North Macedonia.

funFacts.title: PAINTED MOSQUE
funFacts.text: Tetovo's Šarena Džamija, an hour away, is decorated inside and out in floral paint.
